job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities :

Design, develop, test, deploy and maintain scalable backend systems using Python and Fast API.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify requirements and implement solutions that meet business needs.
Develop REST APIs for data ingestion from various sources into our platform's database.
Ensure high availability, performance, security, scalability of the system by monitoring its behavior under different loads.

Job Requirements :

3-6 years of experience in software development with a focus on backend technologies such as Python.
Strong understanding of generative AI concepts and ability to apply them in real-world scenarios.
Experience working with large language models (LLM) or similar technologies is an added advantage.
